title: Binns Memorial Hall

services.name: Hall Rental
services.desc: The Cherrydale Volunteer Fire Department’s Binns Memorial Hall is an event venue available for rent to individuals or groups. We are currently only offering recurring rentals (group fitness classes, club meeting place, etc.). The hall is located on the second floor of the historic Cherrydale Volunteer Fire Department fire station at 3900 Langston Blvd. in Arlington. Looking for a local space to hold your organization’s meetings or to host weekly classes? We’ve got you covered. We offer agreements for recurring use. Email us at hallrental@cherrydalefire.org to inquire. Seating capacity: 225 guests for a stand-up reception, 125 guests for a banquet (not including wait staff) Parking: The
